mapper.select: select alt.task_id, alt.task_name, alt.dataset_id, alt.base_dataset_id, alt.label_type, alt.sub_label_type, alt.data_type, alt.tag_ids, alt.description, alt.create_time, alt.create_by, alt.update_time, alt.update_by, alt.intelligent_annotation_url, alt.description from aircas_label_task alt where alt.del_flag = '0' and task_id = #{taskId}

select al.label_id, sf.id as file_id, sf.bucket_name, sf.original, sf.type, sf.md5, sf.file_size, sf.height, sf.width, al.tag_id, al.create_time, al.create_by, al.update_time, al.update_by, sf.file_name, al.update_time, al.update_by from sys_file sf left join aircas_label al on al.file_id = sf.id and al.del_flag = '0' and al.task_id = #{taskId} where sf.del_flag = '0' and sf.base_dataset_id = #{baseDatasetId}

select al.label_id, al.file_id, sf.bucket_name, sf.original, sf.type, sf.md5, sf.file_size, al.create_time, al.create_by, al.update_time, al.update_by, sf.file_name from aircas_label al left join sys_file sf on al.file_id = sf.id where al.del_flag = '0' and al.task_id = #{taskId} and sf.del_flag = '0' and sf.base_dataset_id = #{baseDatasetId}

select alt.task_id, alt.task_name, alt.dataset_id, alt.base_dataset_id, alt.label_type, alt.data_type, alt.sub_label_type, alt.tag_ids, alt.create_time, alt.create_by, alt.update_time, alt.update_by, alt.intelligent_annotation_url, alt.description from aircas_label_task alt where alt.del_flag = '0' and alt.base_dataset_id = #{baseDatasetId}

select alt.task_id, alt.task_name, alt.base_dataset_id, abd.base_dataset_name, alt.label_type, alt.sub_label_type, alt.data_type, alt.tag_ids, abd.count as image_count, alt.create_time, alt.create_by, alt.update_time, alt.update_by, count(case when al.del_flag = '0' then 1 end) as label_count, alt.intelligent_annotation_url, alt.description from aircas_label_task alt left join aircas_base_dataset abd on alt.base_dataset_id = abd.base_dataset_id left join aircas_label al on al.task_id = alt.task_id where abd.del_flag = '0' and alt.base_dataset_id = #{id} group by alt.task_id order by max(alt.create_time) desc
